\textbf{Register} & \textbf{Writable Image} & \textbf{Validation} & \textbf{Commit and Side Effect}\\

\texttt{PTCR} & root\_page, PABITS\_SEL, LA57, and PE; reserved bits must be zero & PABITS\_SEL is 0 or 1 and the selected root frame fits the selected physical-address width & apply the translation-cache transition selected by the changed fields\\
\texttt{ASCR} & ASID and AE; reserved bits must be zero & the complete ASCR image is validated before commit & apply the translation-cache transition selected by the changed fields\\
\texttt{ECR} & MAX\_EDEPTH and V; NMI\_P is hardware managed and the supplied value is ignored & setting V validates EPC, ECS, EDS, and all configured event stack pairs & replace the complete writable image atomically\\
\texttt{SPC}, \texttt{EPC} & complete 64-bit entry address & 16-byte aligned, canonical, and executable under the matching code-segment image & replace the selected register atomically\\
\texttt{SCS}, \texttt{SDS}, \texttt{ECS}, \texttt{EDS}, \texttt{SSS}, \texttt{ISS}, \texttt{FSS}, \texttt{DSS} & complete 64-bit segment image & apply the architectural segment-image validity rule & replace the selected register atomically\\
\texttt{SSP}, \texttt{ISP}, \texttt{FSP}, \texttt{DSP} & complete 64-bit configured stack top & 64-byte aligned & replace the selected register atomically\\
\texttt{URPC}, \texttt{URSP}, \texttt{URCS}, \texttt{URDS}, \texttt{URSS} & complete 64-bit saved user-return value & defer complete-bank validation until URCTL.V is set or SYSRET executes & replace the selected register atomically\\
\texttt{URCTL} & V, STATUS, and FLAGS; reserved bits must be zero & setting V validates the complete user-return bank and requires saved PM and EA to be zero & replace URCTL atomically after complete-bank validation\\
\texttt{BOOTPC} & complete 64-bit warm-reset target & the value is used as the exact PC after warm RESET & replace BOOTPC atomically\\
\texttt{BOOTCFG} & complete opaque 64-bit platform boot configuration & no image transformation & replace BOOTCFG atomically\\
\texttt{PMC} & EN; reserved bits must be zero & EN is Boolean & replace PMC atomically\\
\bottomrule
